description: Details of a single order (POST /b2b/v1/orders/get): every field the order was created with (cart, delivery_address, payment_type, store_id, …) plus create_time. NOTE: the response does NOT include the order state — use get_orders_state for tracking.

order_id.description: The order id (the client-side id the order was created with).

name: get_order
title: Get order details
